hot.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
hot.summary: Mirage introduces a video world model that uses a latent spatial memory to generate 3D-consistent videos, achieving up to 10.57 times faster end-to-end generation and 55 times lower GPU memory usage compared to prior RGB-based memory approaches while enhancing geometric coherence.

hot.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
hot.summary: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4 implements Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA) to dynamically manage the Key-Value cache, proactively fetching only query-critical historical chunks. This approach reduces the average GPU memory footprint by 86.5% while improving downstream accuracy by 0.6% on long-context benchmarks.

hot.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
hot.summary: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory researchers developed Self-Harness, a paradigm allowing a fixed Large Language Model (LLM) agent to autonomously improve its own operating harness by iteratively diagnosing weaknesses, proposing minimal modifications, and validating them. This method achieved significant performance improvements on the Terminal-Bench-2.0 benchmark across various LLMs, demonstrating the generation of targeted, model-specific harness configurations.

hot.title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
hot.summary: Researchers at McGill University, Mila Quebec AI Institute, and UT Austin developed Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD) to mitigate 'prefix failure' in on-policy distillation for large language models. TRD refines student-generated trajectories, leading to consistent performance improvements, including up to +4.6% Avg@16 on AIME24 and +12.8% Pass@16 on AMOBench for specific Qwen3 models, while also generating substantially shorter, more verifiable reasoning paths.

hot.title: OMG: Omni-Modal Motion Generation for Generalist Humanoid Control
hot.summary: Researchers at Tsinghua University developed OMG, an omni-modal motion generation framework, to enable generalist humanoid control by interpreting diverse human intents. The system leverages a large-scale, curated multi-modal motion corpus and a diffusion-based Motion Transformer, achieving real-time execution of complex, compositional commands on a physical Unitree G1 robot with high fidelity and stability.

hot.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
hot.summary: Kuaishou Group's Keye Team developed Kwai Keye-VL-2.0, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed for understanding ultra-long video contexts and enhancing agentic intelligence. The model addresses extreme context scaling and catastrophic forgetting through sparse attention and multi-teacher distillation, achieving leading performance in temporal localization and strong results in various agent tasks.

hot.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
hot.summary: Researchers at HKUST, UT Austin, Zhejiang University, and others characterized the parameter-space optimization geometry of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) for large language models, finding it occupies a "relaxed off-principal" regime distinct from SFT and RLVR. OPD exhibits "subspace locking" where cumulative updates rapidly converge into a low-dimensional, functionally sufficient channel, primarily controlled by the objective's composition.

hot.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
hot.summary: Next Forcing introduces a multi-chunk prediction framework to enhance causal world models by providing denser temporal supervision, addressing the issue of myopic supervision. It achieves new state-of-the-art performance on robot manipulation tasks, accelerates training by up to 2.3x, and enables 2x inference speedup while improving physical dynamics understanding and general video generation quality.

hot.title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
hot.summary: Researchers from UC Berkeley and Physical Intelligence introduce QGF (Q-Guided Flow), a reinforcement learning algorithm that achieves policy optimization entirely at test time. This method guides a pre-trained flow policy using gradients from a learned Q-function, demonstrating performance competitive with or superior to state-of-the-art training-time RL methods on continuous control tasks, while improving computational efficiency compared to Best-of-N sampling.

hot.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
hot.summary: A real-time World Action Model, MotionWAM, is introduced for humanoid robots, unifying whole-body control into a single motion latent space for complex loco-manipulation tasks. This approach achieved an overall success rate of 76.1% across nine real-world tasks, outperforming existing baselines by over 32% absolute gain and maintaining a closed-loop operating frequency of 4.9 Hz.

hot.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
hot.summary: Researchers from Zhejiang University and Ant Group developed On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), a unified framework that distills knowledge in large language models by directly aligning student and teacher intermediate hidden states on student-generated trajectories. OPRD closes the student-teacher performance gap on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving up to 2.7 points higher accuracy than output-space on-policy distillation baselines, while reducing GPU memory usage by 32-54% and training time by 1.44 times.

hot.title: ConMem: Structured Memory-Guided Adaptation in Training-Free Multi-Agent Systems
hot.summary: ConMem presents a training-free framework for multi-agent systems to achieve continual adaptation by transforming fragmented experiences into structured, coordinated collective memory. It leverages signed strategy cards and a typed graph to provide prompt-side guidance, consistently yielding 10.9% to 12.9% absolute performance gains across diverse benchmarks and host LLM architectures.

hot.title: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows
hot.summary: NF-CoT integrates autoregressive normalizing flows into large language models to enable continuous latent reasoning, replacing verbose textual Chain-of-Thought with compact thought vectors while preserving key LLM properties. This framework achieves an average 13.0% improvement in pass@1 on Python code generation benchmarks over the Qwen3-8B-Base model and is 1.92 times faster overall than diffusion-based latent reasoning methods.

hot.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
hot.summary: AHA-WAM introduces an asynchronous, horizon-adaptive architecture for robot manipulation, decoupling the temporal scales of visual world planning and action execution. This approach achieves a 4.59x inference speedup and a 24.17 Hz control frequency (up to 56.95 Hz with distillation), while maintaining a 92.80% success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and 78.33% on real-world tasks.

hot.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
hot.summary: ABot-Earth 0.5, developed by AMAP CV Lab, Alibaba Group, presents a generative 3D Earth model capable of synthesizing vast, real-world-authentic 3D aerial scenes using 3D Gaussian Splatting and conditioned solely on satellite imagery. The model achieves superior generative fidelity with an FID score of 16.1 and KID of 0.006, and can generate 1 km² of 3D environment in under 10 minutes.

hot.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL
hot.summary: DRPO introduces a novel regularization scheme for large language model reinforcement learning, integrating a divergence-based trust region with smooth quadratic regularization. This approach stabilizes training and improves efficiency, matching or surpassing existing ratio-based and hard-mask methods across diverse LLM architectures and precision environments.

hot.title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
hot.summary: Latent Context Language Models (LCLMs) offer an encoder-decoder framework for compressing large language model input contexts, enabling efficient handling of millions of tokens. This approach achieved up to an 8.8x faster Time To First Token and substantially reduced peak GPU memory compared to KV cache methods, while preserving high accuracy across diverse long-context tasks.

hot.title: MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models
hot.summary: MemoryVLA++ introduces a comprehensive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that integrates explicit past memory and latent-space future imagination to enhance temporal reasoning in robotic manipulation. The model achieved an average success rate of 98.4% on Libero and a 16.6 percentage point improvement over CogACT on SimplerEnv, alongside substantial gains on long-horizon memory-dependent (+26%) and imagination-dependent (+28%) real-robot tasks.

hot.title: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression
hot.summary: Researchers introduced BiWM, the first open-source, full-stack framework for interactive video world models that leverages a bidirectional autoregressive paradigm to generate high-fidelity, controllable video sequences. The system achieves robust camera control and stable long-horizon rollouts through an efficient two-stage training pipeline that converges in hundreds of optimizer steps, adaptable across diverse video diffusion architectures.

hot.title: MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation
hot.summary: MILLIVID, a video generative model, enhances long-range consistency by employing a learned hierarchical tokenizer and a coarse-to-fine rollout strategy. It produces videos with significantly improved object permanence and scene recall over hundreds of frames, demonstrating superior performance on consistency metrics like LPIPS (0.335 vs 0.533 for FramePack) and LightGlue matches (62.4 vs 7.0 for FramePack) while maintaining visual quality.

likes.title: MAI-Thinking-1: Building a Hill-Climbing Machine
likes.summary: Microsoft AI developed MAI-Thinking-1, a 35B active / 1T total parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, using a "hill-climbing machine" framework for continuous, systematic improvement by training exclusively on human-generated data. The model achieved competitive performance against other frontier LLMs in STEM reasoning, coding, and general capabilities, while maintaining a strong helpfulness-safety balance.

likes.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
likes.summary: The World-Language-Action (WLA) model introduces a unified embodied foundation model that integrates world modeling, language reasoning, and action synthesis using an autoregressive Transformer backbone. It demonstrated superior performance on complex, long-horizon manipulation tasks in simulations and real-world scenarios, while achieving significantly reduced inference latency and the ability to learn novel tasks from action-free videos.

likes.title: OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation
likes.summary: OrderGrad introduces a unified framework for optimizing arbitrary finite-sample L-statistic objectives in stochastic learning, providing unbiased likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators. It improves performance in LLM math reasoning tasks, enables effective multi-objective optimization, and offers precise control over gradient pressure across reward distributions.

likes.title: OneReason Technical Report
likes.summary: OneReason is a generative recommendation foundation model that integrates robust itemic token perception and sophisticated, recommendation-specific cognition. It enables a "thinking mode" to consistently outperform a "non-thinking mode" on Kuaishou's real-world benchmarks, resulting in significant online business uplifts.

likes.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
likes.summary: A position paper argues that achieving generalist robot intelligence necessitates overcoming the "grounding bottleneck," which involves converting the world's abundant unstructured physical data into robot-usable supervision. It proposes four architectural pillars—Physical Data Engines, Task-preserving Retargeting, Physics-Grounded World Models, and Self-Improving Deployment Loops—as essential components for a future integrated robot learning system.

likes.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
likes.summary: Mirage introduces a video world model that uses a latent spatial memory to generate 3D-consistent videos, achieving up to 10.57 times faster end-to-end generation and 55 times lower GPU memory usage compared to prior RGB-based memory approaches while enhancing geometric coherence.

likes.title: On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients
likes.summary: Researchers at The University of Tokyo developed MaxPO, an optimization method for max@K policy gradients that introduces a Leave-Two-Out (L2O) baseline to center the advantage estimate. This approach reduced gradient variance by 77.4% on average and improved pass@256 performance by up to 5.2% on math reasoning benchmarks for large language models.

likes.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
likes.summary: Supervised Memory Training (SMT) enables the time-parallel training of nonlinear Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) by framing memory transitions as a supervised learning problem, where a Transformer "teacher" provides optimal memory states. This method overcomes the limitations of traditional Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT), allowing RNNs to effectively learn long-range dependencies and achieve strong performance on diverse sequence modeling tasks with fixed-memory inference.

likes.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
likes.summary: Researchers from Shanghai AI Laboratory and East China Normal University developed MLEvolve, a self-evolving multi-agent framework for automated, end-to-end machine learning algorithm discovery. The framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MLE-Bench benchmark and demonstrates robust generalization across various optimization tasks by integrating progressive search, retrospective memory, and hierarchical planning.

likes.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
likes.summary: The LARA (Latent Action Representation Alignment) framework jointly optimizes Latent Action Models (LAMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by explicitly aligning their intermediate latent representations. This approach enhances VLA model performance and generalization capabilities across various robotic manipulation benchmarks, achieving improved success rates and better adaptation to novel tasks and embodiments.

likes.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
likes.summary: AffordanceVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model developed by researchers at Peking University and collaborators, utilizes structured affordance forecasting as an intermediate representation to improve robotic manipulation. This system achieved an average success rate of 95.8% on the LIBERO benchmark and an Average Length of 4.33 on CALVIN, while also demonstrating enhanced instruction-following and emergent long-horizon capabilities in real-world scenarios.

likes.title: Principles and Practice of Deep Representation Learning: or a Mathematical Theory of Memory
likes.summary: This work establishes a unified theoretical framework for deep learning, reinterpreting deep neural networks as unrolled optimization algorithms that learn low-dimensional data distributions through principles of compression and information gain. It bridges classical analytical models with modern data-driven approaches, offering a mathematically transparent understanding of AI systems and guiding principled architecture design.

likes.title: dots.tts Technical Report
likes.summary: The "dots.tts" system, developed by researchers at dots, Xiaohongshu Inc. and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, introduces a 2B-parameter continuous autoregressive text-to-speech foundation model designed to overcome long-range error accumulation in continuous latent generation. It achieves high fidelity and robust zero-shot voice cloning, outperforming baselines in speaker similarity and text faithfulness while enabling efficient real-time inference.

likes.title: ActiveMimic: Egocentric Video Pretraining with Active Perception
likes.summary: ActiveMimic introduces a two-stage pretraining framework that leverages active perception from in-the-wild egocentric human videos to enhance robot manipulation capabilities. The approach enables robots to learn synchronized viewpoint and manipulation actions, leading to improved performance on real-world tasks such as Restocking (90.1%), Reaching (88.9%), Finding (91.7%), and Pouring (93.3%), often surpassing state-of-the-art models pretrained on robot-specific data.
